title: Bitcoin Price Crashes to $59,000 as Market Selloff Deepens
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Price Crashes to $59,000 as Market Selloff Deepens Bitcoin fell below $60,000 for the first time since early July on Friday as a tech stock rout, rate hike bets and record ETF outflows hit risk assets. This post Bitcoin Price Crashes to $59,000 as Market Selloff Deepens first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
